mechanism_narrative: A low and stable federal funds rate environment (below 0.5%) consistently reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
